name: Soybean Crush Spread: March Elevation → Q2 Mean-Reversion
description: Analyzes whether elevated soybean crush margins in March (z-score > +1 vs 252d history) predict mean-reversion in Q2 (April-June). Uses CBOT board crush formula: (ZM × 44/2000) + (ZL × 11/100) − (ZS/100) with NoAdjustment continuation. Measures forward crush margin changes at 1M, 2M, and 3M horizons from end-of-March, comparing elevated years vs all years.
source:
# Soybean Crush Spread: March Elevation → Q2 Mean-Reversion
# CBOT board crush: (ZM × 44/2000) + (ZL × 11/100) − (ZS/100)
# Signal: crush z-score > +1 at end of March
# Forward: crush margin $ change at 1M, 2M, 3M into Q2

# --- Data: Load all three legs ---
zs_raw = market_data_source()()
zs = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zs_raw.o, zs_raw.h, zs_raw.l, zs_raw.c, zs_raw.v, zs_raw.oi, zs_raw.s)

zm_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZM')()
zm = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zm_raw.o, zm_raw.h, zm_raw.l, zm_raw.c, zm_raw.v, zm_raw.oi, zm_raw.s)

zl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZL')()
zl = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zl_raw.o, zl_raw.h, zl_raw.l, zl_raw.c, zl_raw.v, zl_raw.oi, zl_raw.s)

# --- Crush Spread Calculation ---
# CBOT board crush: meal revenue + oil revenue - bean cost (all per bushel)
# ZM in $/short ton, ZL in cents/lb, ZS in cents/bushel
zs_close = ffill(zs.c)
zm_close = ffill(zm.c)
zl_close = ffill(zl.c)

crush = (zm_close * 44.0 / 2000.0) + (zl_close * 11.0 / 100.0) - (zs_close / 100.0)

# --- Z-Score of Crush Margin (252-day trailing) ---
crush_z = zscore(window=252)(crush)
crush_ma = ma(period=252, type=MAType.sma)(crush)
crush_std = stddev(period=252)(crush)
crush_upper = crush_ma + crush_std
crush_lower = crush_ma - crush_std

# --- Calendar Detection: End of March ---
ts = index()
month = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)
is_march = month.value == 3
is_eom = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month, boundary=BoundaryType.end)(ts)
is_march_end = is_march and is_eom.value

# --- Signal: Elevated crush at end of March (z > +1) ---
is_elevated_march = is_march_end and (is_valid(crush_z.result) and crush_z.result > 1.0)

# --- Forward Crush Margin Changes ($ change, not % return) ---
# Use lead operator on crush level — NOT forward_returns (which divides by current)
crush_1m = crush << 21
crush_2m = crush << 42
crush_3m = crush << 63

# $ change in crush margin from current level
chg_1m = crush_1m - crush
chg_2m = crush_2m - crush
chg_3m = crush_3m - crush

# Filter: elevated March events
elev_chg_1m = where(is_elevated_march, chg_1m)
elev_chg_2m = where(is_elevated_march, chg_2m)
elev_chg_3m = where(is_elevated_march, chg_3m)

# Filter: all March end events (baseline)
all_chg_1m = where(is_march_end, chg_1m)
all_chg_2m = where(is_march_end, chg_2m)
all_chg_3m = where(is_march_end, chg_3m)

# Crush level and z-score at elevated March events (for event markers)
elev_crush_level = where(is_elevated_march, crush)
elev_z_at_event = where(is_elevated_march, crush_z.result)

# Year label for event markers
year_val = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(ts)

# Hit rate helper: did crush decline (mean-revert) over 3M?
elev_reverted_3m = where(is_elevated_march, 1.0 if (is_valid(chg_3m) and chg_3m < 0) else 0.0)

# --- OUTPUT 1: Crush Spread with Z-Score Bands (Context) ---
xy_lines(
    title='Soybean Crush Margin with ±1σ Bands',
    y_axis_label='Crush Margin ($/bu)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    category='Crush Mean-Reversion',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Crush Margin', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='252d Mean', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='+1σ', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='-1σ', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(crush, crush_ma, crush_upper, crush_lower))

# --- OUTPUT 2: Forward Crush Change Bars — Elevated vs All March (Punchline) ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Does Elevated March Crush Mean-Revert into Q2?',
    x_axis_label='',
    y_axis_label='Median Crush Δ ($/bu)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    category='Crush Mean-Reversion',
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1M', stack='Elevated (z>1)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+2M', stack='Elevated (z>1)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+3M', stack='Elevated (z>1)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1M', stack='All March'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+2M', stack='All March'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+3M', stack='All March')
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='No Change', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(elev_chg_1m, elev_chg_2m, elev_chg_3m, all_chg_1m, all_chg_2m, all_chg_3m))

# --- OUTPUT 3: Stats Table (Reference) ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Elevated March Crush → Q2 Stats',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['N (Years)', 'Median Δ ($/bu)', 'Hit Rate (declined)', 'Best Δ ($/bu)', 'Worst Δ ($/bu)'],
        col_headers=['+1M (Apr)', '+2M (May)', '+3M (Jun)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='Crush Mean-Reversion',
    order=3
)(elev_chg_1m, elev_chg_2m, elev_chg_3m, elev_chg_1m, elev_chg_2m, elev_chg_3m, elev_reverted_3m, elev_reverted_3m, elev_reverted_3m, elev_chg_1m, elev_chg_2m, elev_chg_3m, elev_chg_1m, elev_chg_2m, elev_chg_3m)

# --- EVENT MARKERS: Elevated March Crush Events ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Elevated March Crush',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Crush ($/bu)', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='3M Δ ($/bu)', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(title='Year', dp=0, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(elev_z_at_event, elev_crush_level, elev_chg_3m, year_val, is_elevated_march)
